text:
anya: heads-up — qbringup int8-v2 showed a weird quality bump on our codegen promptset after dedupe merge. quick sync?

mike: weird how? numbers?

anya: small but consistent regression on the micro-golden for multi-turn snippets. BLEU-like proxy down ~3.2%, exact-match down 1.8% on the canary subset.

sasha: is this on the full promptset or just multi-turn/code examples?

anya: primarily multi-turn codegen and explainers. single-turn toy prompts look ok.

devin: any chance the dedupe merged near-duplicates from training into the golden? I remember we ran a broad deid pass last week.

anya: suspecting that. after the sampler merge last night we did an aggressive fuzzy dedupe that may have collaterally removed or merged golden anchors.

lia (label-ops): I pulled the labeling history for the affected micro-golden ids — there were two rows flagged as "merged" by fuzzyhash_v2 at 03:14 UTC. they were similar but not identical; labelers had different judgments earlier.

mike: can you paste the IDs? we should check provenance and the pre-merge snapshots.

lia (label-ops): ids: gld-cc-11021, gld-cc-11022, gld-cc-11045.

anya: thanks. @devin can we re-run the int8-v2 eval but pin a resurrected micro-golden that keeps both variants (i.e., undo the merge for those anchors) to see delta?

devin: yes. I'll spin a qbench job. command I'm running:
```
./run_eval.sh --model int8-v2 --prompts micro-golden-codegen-2026-03 --metrics exact_match,bleu,exec_success --out /tmp/qb-int8v2.json
```
should take ~11m for that subset.

eval-bot: CI job queued: qbench-3794500001-int8v2. estimated 11m. link: https://ci.internal/runs/3794500001

mike: while that runs — any config differences between int8-v1 and v2 aside from kernel mapping? eg kvcache layout or prefix handling?

devin: v2 uses an experimental KFloat kernel and slightly different prefix truncation to favor continuity for code completion. could influence multi-turn.

sasha: that aligns with the symptom. truncation change could drop context tokens that the golden expects.

anya: also noticed the dedupe logic now penalizes trailing tokens less, so we probably merged samples that only differed in trailing context. those trailing parts are critical for our codegen tests.

lia (label-ops): quick proposal — set up a micro-golden "non-merge" tag for anchors with multi-turn dependency. we can backfill ~120 anchors flagged by the canary. prevents auto-merge until manual review.

mike: +1. process change needed. can you add a check in the dedupe pipeline to skip items with multi-turn marker?

lia (label-ops): yep, i'll open a small PR. target: skip fuzzyhash merge when metadata.multi_turn == true OR golden_tag == true.

devin: eval done. raw deltas: exact_match -1.9%, bleu -3.1%, exec_success -0.6% (relative). attaching short excerpt:
```
{ "micro_golden": 120, "model": "int8-v2", "baseline": "int8-v1", "exact_match": -1.9, "bleu": -3.1 }
```

anya: hm matches earlier local runs.

sasha: next step: reproduce on a pinned dataset where we restore the three merged anchors as separate entries. devin, can you run the eval against that pinned set?

devin: on it. I'll add a dataset fork: micro-golden-codegen-2026-03-restore1 and rerun.

eval-bot: CI job queued: qbench-3794500001-int8v2-restore1. link: https://ci.internal/runs/3794500048

lia (label-ops): meanwhile i'll mark all anchors with multi-turn heuristics as golden_tag=true and start a manual review queue — target 2 people per anchor. ETA for triage: 24h for top-40, 72h for full 120.

mike: good. we should also add a promptset check in model onboarding: run a differential that isolates dedupe-sensitive anchors and fail the rollout if regression > 1% exact_match on those.

anya: agree. I'll draft a rollout-gate doc. quick checklist: (1) dedupe skip rule, (2) micro-golden restore test, (3) gating metric for multi-turn anchors, (4) labeler QA backfill.

devin: restore run complete: diffs nearly back to baseline when anchors restored: exact_match -0.2%, bleu -0.4%. suggests merge was the primary cause.

anya: that confirms it. thanks team. liA can you hold the dedupe PR for review until we have tests?

lia (label-ops): yep will add unit and e2e for the skip rule and a smoke that runs the micro-golden diff.

mike: and let's keep the rollout paused for int8-v2 canary until the gate is in place. I'll flag it in the release board. :white_check_mark:

anya: great. I'll update the onboarding checklist and close the loop with security/ops. if anything else shows up I'll ping here.

sasha: thanks all. :pray:
